title: kitchen.settings.update
description: Kitchen configuration (one singleton row per hub): KDS display + order behaviour (merge of ADR-0014). The generic settings form of the shell sends the WHOLE snapshot (upsert), so every property is `required` — and therefore every property MUST carry a `default` equal to its column DEFAULT in `migrations/postgres/001_init.sql`. Without it, a hub whose singleton row does not exist yet (every new hub, since the row is born from this form) starts the form empty and its first save is a 422 nobody can get past (kitchen#41). Pinned by `tests/settings_defaults_match_the_column.contract.test.py`. Every property here is READ by code that runs, pinned by `tests/every_setting_moves_something.contract.test.py`: ten controls that reached nothing were retired in kitchen#48 and NINE are still retired (`auto_accept_orders`, `items_per_page`, `auto_refresh_seconds`, `sound_on_new_order`, `sound_on_rush`, `auto_bump_enabled`, `auto_bump_delay_seconds`, `use_rounds`, `auto_fire_on_round`). Their COLUMNS survive with their DEFAULT — dropping one needs a `kind: contract` migration no module can publish — so a hub that had saved values keeps them; the form simply stops offering a switch that moved nothing. The tenth, `auto_print_tickets`, is back in kitchen#70 with a reader and a DIFFERENT meaning — it prints the PASS at the bump, where five of the ten KDS on the market print, not paper at arrival, which station routing already does — and therefore with `default: false` and a column DEFAULT lowered to 0 (migration 009/010): a switch that starts printing paper nobody asked for is a regression, and the market ships this one off.

sound_volume.title: Sound volume (0-100)
sound_volume.description: How loud the chime rings. The default is the volume this module has always rung at; a kitchen with an extractor fan usually needs more.

sound_tone.title: Sound tone
sound_tone.description: Which sound the new ticket makes. The buzzer is the one that carries over a hood at full blast.

auto_print_tickets.title: Print the pass when marked ready
auto_print_tickets.description: Prints the plates that are going out on the printer of their station, every time a ticket is bumped. It is not the kitchen order at fire time, which the station routing already prints.

works_from_screen.title: The kitchen works from the screen
works_from_screen.description: Turn it off if the kitchen works only from the printed order and nobody marks anything on the kitchen screen: charging a check then serves all its rounds, so they leave the screen and the cash-close review. On, a round still cooking stays on the screen until the pass serves it.
